sources.title: Bobcat Flash - a Hugging Face Space by sanghwa-na
sources.snippet: Bobcat Flash (bobcat-flash-1.1): the fast tier for short states, in FP8 on half a GPU. States over 2,048 tokens are the strength of Bobcat: the routed server of the model cards hands them to it; this Space answers them with Flash alone.
